verdict.rationale: Veriff's docs confirm a dedicated biometric liveness feature that verifies the captured biometric data comes from a live person, matching the core story of selfie-to-document liveness matching, but there is no detail on specific anti-spoofing defenses (printed photo, screen replay, video injection) or any independent certification/testing evidence. Missing for 10: documented defenses against specific spoof types (print/screen/replay), independent liveness certification (e.g., iBeta/NIST), and hands-on/third-party validation of match accuracy.
